Critical Alerts in the app vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume Critical Alerts entitlement approval covers storefront language. Apple entitlement review and App Store Connect actually separate break-through notification delivery from product-page copy:

  • Critical Alerts permission (紧急警告) — separate user consent after regular notification permission; allows approved apps to deliver notifications that break through Focus and Do Not Disturb with a critical sound. Runtime system behavior — does not generate Chinese listing text.
  • Critical Alerts entitlement — Apple-reviewed capability (com.apple.developer.usernotifications.critical-alerts) required before your app can request Critical Alerts permission. Developer Program and App Review work — not listing rewrite.

Critical Alerts–specific listing copy — what translates differently

Critical Alerts listings use vocabulary general Priority Notifications or push-permission guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers evaluate break-through notification claims — not a literal paste of US marketing:

紧急警告 vs 紧急通知 vs 突破勿扰

US pages say "Critical Alerts", "Critical Alert permission", or "Break through Do Not Disturb." China storefront copy often uses 紧急警告 for Critical Alerts permission badge callouts matching Apple's zh-Hans Settings vocabulary, 紧急通知 when gallery frames emphasize critical notification delivery overlays, and 突破勿扰 or 突破专注模式 when marketing break-through-Focus or break-through-Do-Not-Disturb value props. AppLocale aligns phrasing with each screenshot frame — not one blanket term for every overlay.

Critical Alerts vs Priority Notifications — do not conflate

Priority Notifications (优先通知) ranks and surfaces time-sensitive alerts in the notification stack using Apple Intelligence. Critical Alerts (紧急警告) is a separate permission with entitlement review that delivers notifications with a critical sound even when Focus or Do Not Disturb is active and the ringer is muted. Listing caption lines should match the surface your screenshot shows — a Critical Alerts Allow prompt is not a Priority Notifications settings toggle.

Critical Alerts vs Reduce Interruptions — do not conflate

Reduce Interruptions (减少干扰) is Apple Intelligence triage that filters low-priority pings while letting important notifications through. Critical Alerts is an explicit user-granted permission for approved apps to break through with a critical sound. If your English gallery shows Reduce Interruptions Focus branding, do not upgrade zh-Hans copy to Critical Alerts claims unless that frame shows the Critical Alerts permission prompt.

Critical Alerts vs Hide Alerts and Flash Alerts — do not conflate

Hide Alerts (隐藏提醒) mutes one Messages conversation thread. Flash Alerts (闪光灯提醒) makes the camera LED flash for notifications. Critical Alerts breaks through Focus and Do Not Disturb with a critical sound — a different buyer story, different screenshot vocabulary, different Settings path.

FAQ

What are Critical Alerts and why do they matter for listing copy?

Critical Alerts are an iOS notification permission and interruption level that lets an approved app deliver notifications that break through Focus and Do Not Disturb with a critical sound. Marketing those surfaces on your en-US page does not auto-fill a zh-Hans localization row.

Are Critical Alerts the same as Priority Notifications or Reduce Interruptions?

No. Priority Notifications (优先通知) covers Apple Intelligence notification prioritization and time-sensitive surfacing in the stack. Reduce Interruptions (减少干扰) covers intelligent on-device triage. Critical Alerts (紧急警告) is a separate permission with entitlement review that breaks through Focus and Do Not Disturb with a critical sound. See our Priority Notifications listing guide and Reduce Interruptions listing guide for those buyer stories — not Critical Alerts permission marketing.

Are Critical Alerts the same as Notification Summary, Hide Alerts, or Flash Alerts?

No. Notification Summary (通知摘要) is scheduled digest delivery. Hide Alerts (隐藏提醒) is per-conversation Messages mute. Flash Alerts (闪光灯提醒) is camera LED flash for notifications. Critical Alerts is break-through-Focus critical sound permission — see those dedicated guides only if those surfaces dominate your gallery.

Are Critical Alerts the same as Emergency SOS or Crash Detection?

No. Emergency SOS covers emergency call and satellite SOS workflows. Crash Detection covers fall and crash sensor alerts. Critical Alerts covers UserNotifications critical interruption level permission. See our Emergency SOS listing guide for emergency calling scope — not notification permission overlays.

Does AppLocale implement Critical Alerts entitlements or UNNotificationInterruptionLevel.critical code?

No. We deliver Connect listing metadata copy only — name, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text when included, and screenshot caption lines. Critical Alerts entitlement requests and UserNotifications engineering are outside AppLocale scope.

No. Search intents for critical-alert, critical-notification, critical-notifications, bypass-focus-alerts, breakthrough-alerts, urgent-alerts, and emergency-alerts fold onto this Critical Alerts-as-lead page when that feature dominates your gallery.

Listing copy may use 紧急警告 for Critical Alerts permission badges, 紧急通知 for critical notification delivery overlays, and 突破勿扰 or 突破专注模式 for break-through-Focus value props. AppLocale aligns phrasing with your English claims; we do not invent entitlement coverage your app has not received.
